integrity: Proof is self-contained. Exact finite checks support but do not replace the infinite argument. Relevant cubical primary literature is credited; independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The arithmetic maximum over primitive vectors is a finite formula, not an elementary closed form for arbitrary a,b; interior-winner rectangles are exhibited in an infinite family but not fully classified; no extension is asserted outside standard Euclidean rectangular integer boxes.
title: Rectangular lattice kissing distances and interior primitive extremizers
